equivalence.check: byte identity of every preserved segment: equal bytes and equal SHA-256 in both files, and a partition of both files by the preserved and adapted segments (tests/test_current_host_readback_provider_v02.py, ProbeSegmentTests)
equivalence.parser: No JavaScript parser is available in this phase: the phase starts no Node and installs nothing, so neither node --check nor an npm parser can run. No token or AST comparison was executed.
equivalence.strength: Byte identity of a segment implies identical tokens for any JavaScript tokenizer, since the token stream is a function of the bytes. It is therefore stronger than token equivalence, which P05 section 6 requires. It is not a syntax check of the adapted segments; the probe syntax start of contract section 7 (one Node start at MH) remains the first execution of this file.
